normal.label: Normal
normal.advice: Your heart rhythm signal is stable and within the normal physiological range. Keep monitoring your health regularly.

uncertain.label: Inconclusive
uncertain.advice: Some segments of the data contain mild noise. The result is for reference only; consider measuring again while sitting still.

afibSuspected.label: Suspected AFib
afibSuspected.advice: There are signs of arrhythmia or mildly irregular R-R interval variability. Measuring again at rest is recommended.

afib.label: AFib alert
afib.advice: The AI detected heart rate variability consistent with atrial fibrillation. Please contact a cardiologist for a diagnosis.

processing.label: Analyzing
processing.advice: The data is being analyzed by the AI model. Please wait a moment...

failed.label: Analysis failed
failed.advice: The signal is too short or contains too much motion noise. Please measure again while at rest.

unknown.label: No conclusion yet
unknown.advice: This record is waiting for data synchronization.

measure.title: AFib Screening
measure.protocolSteps:
1. Sit still in a comfortable chair with back support.
2. Keep your arm at heart level.
3. Do not move or talk during the 60-second measurement.
4. The PPG sensor will automatically capture the optical signal and send it to the AI model for analysis.
measure.instruction: Keep your arm still and the strap snug on your wrist for the entire 60-second measurement.

wave.title: Pulse waveform (PPG) during the session
wave.hint: Each peak is one heartbeat. Regular waves → stable rhythm; chaotic waves with irregular amplitude → abnormal rhythm.

poincare.title: Poincaré plot
poincare.dotExplain: Each dot is a pair of consecutive heartbeats: the horizontal position is the previous beat interval, the vertical position is the next beat interval.
poincare.tight: A tight cluster hugging the diagonal → regular heart rhythm.
poincare.scattered: A widely scattered, cloud-like cluster → abnormal beat-to-beat variability, a typical pattern of atrial fibrillation.
poincare.basedOn: Based on {{count}} beat intervals recorded during the session.
